name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The user aims to accurately record and monitor various physical activities, both automatically and manually, to maintain a complete log of their exercise habits.
The user seeks clear and insightful visual representations of their fitness data to easily assess consistency, identify trends, and understand improvements over time.
The user desires the ability to define, customize, and track specific fitness goals to maintain focus, achieve targets, and stay motivated throughout their fitness journey.
The user expects to receive personalized workout plans and suggestions that adapt to their fitness level, preferences, and goals, optimizing their training efficiency.
The user aims for effortless and real-time integration with their wearable devices to automatically capture and update accurate fitness data within the application.
The user wants to easily share their fitness activities, milestones, and progress on social media platforms to engage with their network, celebrate accomplishments, and inspire others.
The wearable device aims to reliably collect and transmit fitness data (e.g., heart rate, steps, calories) to the application without manual intervention.
The wearable device's goal is to continuously sync updated fitness metrics with the application, providing the user with the most current information.
lowLevelGoals: The user can start an automatic tracking session for a chosen activity.
The user can add details of an activity they performed previously.
The user can modify information about an activity already recorded.
The user can see a consolidated overview of their activities for a specific day.
The user can create reports to analyze their fitness patterns over longer periods.
The user can see a visual representation of how close they are to achieving a goal.
The user can customize when and how they receive notifications about their fitness achievements.
The system automatically alerts the user when they achieve a fitness milestone or complete a goal.
The user can create a new objective for their fitness journey.
The user can adjust the parameters of a goal they have already set.
The user can indicate when they have successfully achieved a goal.
The user gets suggestions for exercises tailored to their current physical condition.
The user can narrow down workout suggestions based on their preferred exercise categories.
The user can store a suggested workout routine to use later.
The user can rate or comment on a workout they've finished to influence future recommendations.
The system uses user ratings and comments to refine and personalize subsequent workout suggestions.
The user can establish a link between their fitness tracker and the application.
The user can check if their wearable device is currently connected and syncing.
The user can initiate a data transfer from their wearable device to the application.
The user can post details of a completed activity to their social network.
The user can post their fitness milestones or overall progress to their social network.
The user can control who sees their shared fitness information.
The device sends heart rate information to the app without interruption.
The device sends step count information to the app.
The device sends estimated calorie expenditure information to the app.
The device sends geographical position information to the app during outdoor exercises.
The device automatically sends new fitness data to the app at regular intervals.
The device alerts the app when an activity tracking session ends.
The device catches up on any data that wasn't sent during a temporary disconnection.
